title: Tribal Areas Restoration of Jurisdiction Act 1964

sections.shortTitle: Tribal Areas Restoration of Jurisdiction Act 1964
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE TRIBAL AREAS (RESTORATION OF JURISDICTION) ACT, 1964
THE TRIBAL AREAS
(RESTORATION OF JURISDICTION) ACT, 1964.
ACT No. II OF 1964
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1964,
Ext. p. 158b.)
[7th
April, 1964]
An Act to restore
the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the
High Court in
relation to the Tribal Areas of the Quetta Division.
1. Short title and
commencement------(1) This Act may be called the Tribal Areas (Restora tion
of Jurisdiction) Act, 1964.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the tenth day of January,
1964.

sections.shortTitle: Tribal Areas Restoration of Jurisdiction Act 1964
sections.description:
Restoration of jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the High Court

THE TRIBAL AREAS (RESTORATION OF JURISDICTION) ACT, 1964
THE TRIBAL AREAS
(RESTORATION OF JURISDICTION) ACT, 1964.
ACT No. II OF 1964
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1964,
Ext. p. 158b.)
[7th
April, 1964]
An Act to restore
the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the
High Court in
relation to the Tribal Areas of the Quetta Division.
2. Restoration of Jurisdiction
of the Supreme Court and the High Court----The Supreme Court and the High
Court of West Pakistan shall exercise in relation to the Tribal Areas of the
Quetta Division the same jurisdiction as was exercisable by them in relation to
those areas before the commencement of the Con stitution (First Amendment) Act,
1963. I of 1964

An Act to restore

High Court in
relation to the Tribal Areas of the Quetta Division.
3. Extension of
limitation-----Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the
time being in force, if a period of limitation had begun to run from before the
commencement of the Constitution (First Amendment) Act, 1963, in respect of any
matter concerning which the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the High
Court of West Pakistan is created or restored by this Act then in com puting
such period of limitation the period between the tenth day of January, 1964,
and the date of the coming into force of this Act shall be excluded: I of 1964.
Provided that no period of such
limitation shall expire on a day earlier than the thirtieth day from such date.
